reviews.title: Great Keyboard
reviews.comment: I work from home and decided to get this mainly for productivity purposes. Prior to this keyboard I tried the Corsair Vanguard 98, Razr Hunstman, keychron q6 HE, q6 max, and the Rainy. This is by far the best keyboard I have ever tired. The lights are bright, software is easy to use, and the build quality is excellent. The best feature in my opinion of this keyboard is how the keys feel. Out of all the keyboards I tried this has the best typing experience in my opinion. I initially tried the tactile switches but returned it and bought one with the clicky switches. I found the clicky switches to be quiet (as clicky switches can be) and very satisfying to type with. I love the feedback of these switches. The software is also easy to use I’m not sure why some of the other reviews say otherwise. Logitech really did an amazing job on this one. I highly recommend!
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Amazing keyboard
reviews.comment: The keyboard is fantastic I've bought 3 so far, first one was amazing and flawless until I fell asleep one night and spilt beer all over it. Second one I bought had failed key switches so had to return it. Waiting on the third one. Other than that the sleek light weight design is comfortable for the hands snd the sounds of the click is amazing to hear I love the typing asmr
reviews.author: raymond wagner

reviews.title: Pretty good not perfect
reviews.comment: Great size, well built, and very clicky. The only issue I have is the spacebar is not clicky unless pressio directly in the middle. The full size and clicky all the way through. The space bar is very sensitive too, I like to rest my thumb lightly on the space bar and it'll often register the resting as a press.
reviews.author: Alex N.

reviews.title: Beautiful, shoddy keyboard
reviews.comment: It looks nice, but it has been steadily falling apart since I bought it. The red in the back tick/tilde key's LED stopped responding so I'm stuck with mixtures of blue and green. The left control key stopped working and the enter and G keys are going the same way, working intermittently but getting worse. The volume roller stopped working very early, too and the up and right arrow keycaps falls off. It's one of the worst keyboards I've used and for the exorbitant price that's absolutely unforgiveable. I bought this keyboard to have a solid, well-made, well-functioning keyboard to use for years; it's not even been two years and I'm already searching for a replacement. I used to buy Logitech products almost exclusively, and the few times I ventured into some other brand I came back fairly quickly because the quality and reliability made them worth the price. But after this keyboard I can't see myself buying another Logitech product.
reviews.author: TensOfThousands

reviews.title: Returning. Horrible software
reviews.comment: Logitech makes fantastic keyboards: they are my go to brand. The software (G Hub) sucks. Non-intuitive (and I am a senior dev, 40 yrs exp). I would rather script this vs the BS, non-intuitive designs. Has anyone, ANYONE at Logitech consulted a usability or UI person? I have no idea how to get this programmed w/o looking elsewhere. They only show what the device supports, ok, but you should gray out vs not show. None of the instructions from Grok or ChatGPT can figure it out. Numlock trick in Diablo does not work. I am getting mouse elbow which is why I bought it. I am sure if I bang my head against the wall for a few more hours, I will find the magic combo that works. Frankly, navigation is just horrible so not worth the pain. Returning it. Switching to Steel Series to see if they have same issue.
